newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle steady, light test - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle steady, light test - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were steady in a light test, compared to Wednesday's close, USDA said. Trade was fairly slow and demand moderate. Seller interest and offerings were light.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1200-1300 lbs 63.50-64.00. Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1150 lbs ld 63.50.
Carcass Basis (weight only) Compared Wednesdays close -
Slaughter steers and heifers not fully established.

Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1200-1250 lbs few 103.50. Holstein - (weight only) Select and Choice 2-3 1250-1400 lbs 2 lds 101.00. Holsteins -(grade and weight) Choice 2-3 1250-1450 lbs no sales. Select 2-3 1250-1450 lbs no sales. Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales.
For the week - 15,000 Wk ago - 19,300 yr ago - 30,400 Steers and heifers - Live basis - $0.50-$1.00 lower. Carcass basis - $1.00, instances $2.00 lower.
